security_spec.violation_condition: If XiangShan implements CTR and a not-taken conditional branch instruction retires, ctrtarget must be written with the PC of the next sequential instruction (branch_PC + 4 or branch_PC + 2 for compressed), NOT the branch's architectural target address. A hardware bug where the branch target (computed by the branch unit) is incorrectly latched into ctrtarget instead of the fall-through PC for a not-taken branch would violate this spec.
security_spec.summary: XiangShan has zero CTR implementation currently (no ctrtarget/ctrsource CSR, no CTR recording logic); futher implementation must ensure not-taken branch ctrtarget records sequential fall-through PC, not the architectural branch target — recording the wrong destination would corrupt control-flow trace integrity.
